arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Smith argued the law is unconstitutional for two separate reasons.
He stated the act requires libraries to engage in presumptively unconstitutional conduct.
Mr. Olson argued blocking pornography is similar to excluding books from shelves.
He claimed offering internet access without pornography expands freedom of speech.
